description: Source file defining the 'HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P' class, which implements an experimental HTML5-based parser leveraging Jeroen van der Meer's PH5P library. It also includes classes 'HTML5' and 'HTML5TreeConstructer' for parsing and tree construction, handling tokenization, error handling, and DOM building for HTML content within the HTMLPurifier project.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P
classes.description: Implements an experimental HTML5 parser that uses the PH5P library to parse HTML content, with fallback to DirectLex in case of DOM extension errors. It primarily provides tokenization for the HTML content in the context of the HTMLPurifier project.

classes.name: HTML5
classes.description: Provides methods to parse HTML5 content, manage HTML entities, and generate tokens from HTML input. Acts as the core parser class leveraging the PH5P library to process HTML documents.

classes.name: HTML5TreeConstructer
classes.description: Handles the construction of DOM trees from tokens emitted by the HTML5 parser, managing different insertion phases and modes according to HTML5 parsing rules, creating DOM nodes, and appending them to form a valid document structure.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P

classes.name: HTML5

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Tokenizes the input HTML string using the HTML5 parser, normalizes and wraps the HTML, and handles errors by falling back to DirectLex if DOM extension errors occur.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Returns the constructed DOM tree after parsing is complete.

methods.name: emitToken
methods.description: Emits a token to the tree constructor and updates the content model state accordingly.

methods.name: HTML5::__construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTML5 parser with the input data, setting up parser state variables.

methods.name: HTML5::save
methods.description: Returns the current state of the constructed DOM document.

methods.name: HTML5::entity
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities within the input data to their corresponding characters.

methods.name: HTML5TreeConstructer::__construct
methods.description: Initializes the DOM document and sets parser phases and modes.

methods.name: HTML5TreeConstructer::emitToken
methods.description: Processes emitted tokens based on the current parser phase and insertion mode, building the DOM tree.
